title: P2VA: CONVERTING PERSONA DESCRIPTIONS INTO VOICE ATTRIBUTES FOR FAIR AND CONTROLLABLE TEXT-TO-SPEECH

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying LLM-generated voice attributes from persona descriptions to measure skewed baseline gender assignments (e.g., defaulting to male voices) and analyzing the stereotypical co-occurrence of gender with specific vocal traits like tone, speed, and pitch.

Analyzing the distribution of LLM-assigned accent attributes to identify the overrepresentation of Western accents (e.g., North American and British) and the underrepresentation of other global accents.
